acceptanceCriteria: A proposed spec amendment defines the filter, the timestamp fields and their derivation, lastCompletion, windowed counts and the advisory stalled signal, with numbered requirements, failure modes and rollback.
`ticket list --status COMPLETED,OPEN` returns only matching tickets with stable paging; an unknown status refuses with a stable code.

statusChangedAt/lastAttemptEndedAt are derived from receipts deterministically; queue status reports lastCompletion and 1 h / 24 h completion counts; a store with no completion reports null, not a guess.
Dispatch status and events report sessions since the last state change per ticket and emit a typed advisory stalled signal past the configured N; it never holds or blocks dispatch.
Reads never mutate and stay bounded: on a 15,000-receipt store, queue status and filtered list complete in milliseconds without a full receipt scan per call (measured).
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#661 (build main-0b45b05, 2026-10-07): an adopter queue completed no ticket for about 46 h while the dispatcher ran about 170 sessions, each reported as finished (exit 0, progress recorded); finding this needed a scan of about 15,000 receipts. `ticket list --status COMPLETED` refuses MALFORMED (list takes only --offset/--limit/--summary/--fields); records carry no status-change timestamps; `queue status` has byStatus counts only; dispatch never surfaces repeated sessions on one ticket without a state change; loop detection (#587/#609) is opt-in and keyed on candidate trees, so it cannot see evidence/status-only programs. Requests: (1) `ticket list --status S[,S]` plus --fields access to statusChangedAt (or completedAt) and lastAttemptEndedAt; (2) `queue status` lastCompletion {ticketId, at, receipt} and completions per 1 h / 24 h window; (3) dispatch status/events: sessions per ticket since its last state change and an advisory typed `stalled` signal past N sessions with no status transition (not a hold). Must stay ms-scale on large stores (no full receipt scan per read).
